description: Computation is agreed and deterministic; the legal entitlement is contested. Downstream consumers must not treat the computed number as a settled claim.

cases.name: high rate challenged as penalty under UCC 2-718

dispute.contention: Payer contends the 36% per-annum charge is an unenforceable penalty rather than a reasonable liquidation (lex-us-ny-ucc-2-718); payee contends it reflects anticipated financing cost.
